name: Applied Engineering Technology Management
description: Offers programs that combine applied engineering technology with management skills for running technical projects and operations.

name: Biology
description: Offers biology courses and degrees, from cells and organisms to ecosystems and human health.

name: Chemistry
description: Offers chemistry courses and degree programs, with hands-on lab instruction. Also teaches the chemistry that other science and engineering majors need.

name: Civil and Environmental Engineering
description: Offers civil and environmental engineering programs, covering the design of structures, roads, and water systems and the protection of the environment.

name: Computer Science and Software Engineering
description: Offers computer science and software engineering courses and degrees, covering programming, software development, and related computing topics.

name: Criminal Justice and Forensic Investigation
description: Offers criminal justice and forensic investigation courses and degrees, covering the justice system, law enforcement, and the analysis of evidence.

name: Electrical and Computer Engineering
description: Offers electrical engineering and computer engineering courses and degrees, covering circuits, electronics, power, and computing systems.

name: Engineering Physics
description: Offers engineering physics courses and degrees that combine physics with engineering applications.

name: Environmental Sciences and Society
description: Offers courses and degrees that study the environment together with its social, economic, and policy sides.

name: Health and Human Performance
description: Offers courses and degrees in health, physical education, exercise, and human movement.

name: History and Social Sciences
description: Offers courses and degrees in history and the social sciences, which study societies, politics, and human behavior.

name: Humanities
description: Offers courses and degrees in humanities fields such as language, literature, and philosophy.

name: Mathematics
description: Offers mathematics courses and degrees, and teaches the math courses that many other majors require.

name: Mechanical and Industrial Engineering
description: Offers mechanical and industrial engineering courses and degrees, covering machine design, manufacturing, and improving how systems and processes work.

name: Performing and Visual Arts
description: Offers courses and degrees in the performing and visual arts, such as music, theatre, and art.

name: Psychology
description: Offers psychology courses and degrees on human behavior, thinking, and mental health.

name: School of Agriculture
description: Offers agriculture programs that prepare students for careers in farming, food production, and agribusiness.

name: School of Business
description: Offers business courses and degrees in areas such as accounting, finance, marketing, and management.

name: School of Education
description: Prepares students to become teachers and offers education degrees and teacher licensure programs.
